barangayIntro: Explore source-published barangay names and compare the available population figures. Select a name to see its records and sources.
barangayDetailIntro: Published population and source records for this exact name. Source spellings are preserved, not merged.
rosterUnresolved: A current official roster is not confirmed.
rosterExplanation: The municipal page displays 17 names, an ordinance title states 19 barangays, and PhilAtlas lists 19. These are separate claims—not a reconciled official roster.
rosterNamesNote: Labayo and Layasin appear only in the secondary list. Mahipon and Mahipon-Lumot remain separate names until an official crosswalk is available.
noNamedPopulation: No published population for this exact name
noNamedPopulationNote: Do not borrow the value of a similarly named entry. A missing value is not zero.
populationSourceNote: PhilAtlas figures for 2015 and 2020; direct PSA cross-check pending. Bar lengths compare published counts, not growth rates.
geographyIntro: Explore the town and surrounding landscape using the same interactive map as the homepage. Pan, zoom or reset the view.
geographyCoordinateNote: These coordinate ranges are source text, not a surveyed boundary or a downloadable GIS layer.
mapPrivacy: The map loads third-party resources from OpenFreeMap. Its provider receives your IP address; see Privacy & data use.
servicesIntro: Find published office contacts and check the official Citizens’ Charter before preparing an application.
serviceMissing: Service instructions are not available yet
serviceMissingText: The captured Citizens’ Charter page had headings but no service entries. Requirements, fees, eligibility and processing times have not been verified. This does not mean services are unavailable.
serviceLegislationLeadsText: These are historical titles from the official ordinance index, not verified currently available services. The attachments have not been reviewed; do not infer current eligibility, fees or steps from these titles. Confirm details with the responsible office.
beforeVisitText: Confirm requirements, fees, opening hours and processing times directly with the responsible office. This snapshot cannot confirm them.
contactIntro: Phone numbers as published on the municipal website. Select an office or tap a number to call.
contactTitle: Published by the municipality · not live-validated
contactLimit: We have not confirmed that these numbers still work or that offices are currently operating. Do not rely on this snapshot as current emergency guidance.
governmentIntro: Find people, offices and local government records. Published directory entries are not a confirmed current-term roster.
officialsDescription: People and roles published in municipal directories
officesDescription: Published phone numbers for public offices
committeesDescription: Committee assignments named in the source
barangaysDescription: Source-published barangay names and population records
termsDescription: Legislative term coverage and its limits
officialsIntro: Browse the municipality’s published directory. Names and roles retain the source wording; term dates have not been established.
directoryPlaceholder: Search a name, role or office…
facilitiesIntro: Find captured school directory entries and health-office contacts. This is not a complete or verified current facilities register.
schoolLimit: Listed in a secondary directory; not checked against the current DepEd masterlist.
healthLimit: A municipal health contact is available. Facility registration, services and opening hours are not verified.
advisoriesIntro: Go directly to official weather and hazard resources. This portal does not publish a live alert feed.
noLiveAlerts: No live advisories are available here
noLiveAlertsText: An empty snapshot does not mean there is no active warning. Check official sources for current conditions and instructions.
hazardLimit: Hazard maps and location assessments are reference tools, not live emergency warnings.
planLimit: The official index references the plan. Its full text and indicators have not been extracted.
financeIntro: Explore the available document leads and see what is missing before drawing conclusions about municipal finances.
financeMissing: A financial chart would be misleading here
financeMissingText: No complete, directly verified Cavinti financial series is available in this snapshot. Missing values are unknown—not zero. Document-title amounts cannot be used as verified budget or spending totals.
documentLimit: Index references only. Document contents and amounts have not been verified; a barangay budget is not the municipal budget.
demographicsIntro: Explore source-published population figures across time. These are captured observations, not a forecast or a complete statistical profile.
chartDescription: Population by reference year. Use the year buttons to inspect each published value and its source.
secondaryValue: Secondary published figure · PSA cross-check pending
indexedValue: PSA search-index figure · direct access blocked
chartNoInterpolation: The line connects captured reference years; it does not supply values for the years between them.
rateNote: Published by PhilAtlas, not calculated by this portal. PSA cross-check pending.
dataTable: View published values and source notes
catalogueIntro: Browse the captured datasets and download a format that works for you. Record counts describe captured rows, not complete municipal coverage.
sourcePlaceholder: Search publisher, coverage or access status…
sourceIntro: Inspect who published the evidence, what was captured and what could not be checked. Open an entry for its verification and access details.
